notes.title: SONAR 2017.08 Update - Is now Available!
notes.notes:
This month’s release for SONAR brings new features along with fixes & enhancements to many key elements of SONAR. 

[h1]New Features[/h1] 
 
The Start Screen is an important part of SONAR, in this update we have continued to refine it by making the project creation process more straightforward with new templates, we are now displaying Demo Projects when installed (Coming Soon), and with the Discover tab you be able to more easily find news about Cakewalk and SONAR.  

[b]The New Discover Tab[/b] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22396481/33a1824422e5d53ec69530444d0bc334bf5774e9.png[/img]

The Start Screen will now display new notifications through the Discover Tab. In this tab you’ll see news about Cakewalk and SONAR, New Expansion Packs, Free content from our 30th Anniversary Celebration and be able to find all the latest issues of Tech+Music. 

[b]New Demo Projects[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22396481/772c125b519a865dd039dc3ed7661bac2890f97c.png[/img]

When the forthcoming Demo Projects installer is installed onto the computer the Start Screen will now display a Demo Projects tab. The Demo Projects installer will be available for all versions of SONAR including SONAR Artist, Professional, and Platinum. The Demo projects are a great way to get started with SONAR for first time users but can also be used to experiment with new features. We’ll be continuing to add new news as well as periodically refresh them with new content.  

[b]Start Screen Improvements[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22396481/74cddc4fa03cc8308b13320a9c5e6e30f1fa42e3.png[/img]

Using Ctrl + N or Ctrl+O it is now possible to create a new default project from the Start Screen as well as open a project from your drive. Clicking the New Project tab will now display templates and in this update we have streamlined the templates that are installed with SONAR. In addition, using the list view now display 16 projects simultaneously.  New users will now see 6 templates installed for each version of SONAR; Empty Project, Basic, 4-Track, 16-Track, Guitar Amps, and Vocals.

[b]Simplified Help Menu[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22396481/c146e988a27dede9ccaa9102b985d091706e88e5.png[/img]

The help menu in SONAR previously had many many things in there and could sometimes be confusing to navigate. We have simplified this greatly and made the menu much more straightforward. 

[b]30th Anniversary CA-X Amps[/b]
These 30 TH3 based virtual amps pay homage to classic amp sounds without the limitations. They have loads of personality and provide a simple drag-and-drop solution to different guitar tones. There are 5 bass amps, 5 clean amps, 5 rock and blues amps, 7 high-gain amps, 4 pedalboards, an acoustic piezo amp, and two “bonus” humbucker-to-single-coil FX Chains. All amps are setup in stereo, and can additionally be used in the ProChannel.

[b]TECH+MUSIC[/b]
This month's issue covers the latest SONAR 2017.08 updates, uses one of the new demo projects to show how to get better vocals, reviews the unique “Aroma” plug-in for mixing and mastering, describes a fascinating “Anatomy of a SONAR Project,” provides expert tips on mastering in the “You Mix, We Master” monthly feature, and gives full descriptions of the 30 free amp sim FX Chains that are part of the 30th Anniversary Celebration.

[url=https://issuu.com/cakewalkinc/docs/2017.08_tech_music]Read More[/url]

[h1]Fixes and Enhancements[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
• Paste Special did not respect Destination Track in some situations during Paste
• Creating FX Chains previously not add parameters to a control unless it was added twice
[b]Stability[/b]
• Dithering to 24-bit when exporting FLAC previously could cause unexpected crackles in the exported file
• Resolved an issue where SONAR may crash on OMF Export
[b]Track View[/b]
• Drag reordering a bus would was off by 1 when moved to a new position
• Editing minimized Track View clips was previously difficult to slip-edit/crop on the right edge
[b]Piano Roll View[/b]
• The Transform Tool no longer bounces clips together when doing velocity changes
• The Transform button now reflects Hard or Soft mode in the button when switching
• The Transform Tool’s Mask mode will now respond to Hard and Soft mode when Drawing through the Transform box
• Transform Tool now responds correctly when “Show Velocity on Selected Notes Only” is selected
• Transform Tool did not display preview correctly in certain conditions

As with every release, if you experience issues, you can safely roll back via:
• Right-Clicking on SONAR in the Steam Client
• Go to Properties
• Go to the Beta Tab
• Select the "07.2017" beta branch (or another)
• Allow Steam to Update SONAR
• Launch SONAR

notes.title: SONAR 2017.06 - (Update 2) Is now Available!
notes.notes:
This month's release of SONAR had a few issues and we'd like to let you all know that there is now an updated version of the 2017.06 release. This update includes several fixes related to Quick Grouping, an issue with DPI recognition, and a possible crash with comping. 
 
Fixed in 2017.06 build 24
• Quick Group color or ProChannel not working as expected
• Using Speed Comping could cause a crash when picking a section
• SONAR could display abnormally on some TV displays

notes.title: 01.2017 Help Update Pass & Additional Launch Options
notes.notes:
[h1]Updated Help Documentation:[/h1][list]
[*] All Install languages updated to the latest local offline help
[*] All Install languages will now deliver a copy of the SONAR Reference and User Guides. 
[i]Note:[/i] If localized versions of the file(s) aren't available, we provide English copies for the time being.
[*] When a 'SONAR - [Version] Help' DLC is selected, Steam will provide a SONAR User Guide and SONAR Reference Guide pdf launch options.
[i]Note:[/i] If you've upgraded between versions, you may want to deselect redundant help dlc's from the respective lower versions.[/list]
SONAR is a large application and localization can sometimes take longer than an update cycle. Moving forward we will sometimes be taking a "tick/tock" approach to updating the core SONAR features and then supporting documentation. This reduces download sizes, efficiently utilizes testing assets, and allows us to be a bit more agile in deployment dates.

[h1]Merged 2015 Season Content for Professional & Platinum Users:[/h1][list]
[*] ProChannel Presets - Approximately a dozen re-added
[*] FX Chains - A few were missing from the Anderton Collection
[*] NYC Showroom Impulses - [url=https://www.cakewalk.com/Documentation?product=SONAR&language=3&help=NewFeatures.093.html]How to Use[/url]
[*] Anderton Synthetic Impulses - [url=https://www.cakewalk.com/Documentation?product=SONAR&language=3&help=NewFeatures.082.html]How to Use[/url][/list]
We've pulled in some content from the 2015 Season so users don't need duplicate installs. 

The Impulses responses now live under /Cakewalk Content/

[h1]Steam Edition Content Curation:[/h1]
We've moved the Polybius Soundboard Project into the new '/Cakewalk Content/Demo Projects/' folder location introduced in Update 11.2016. 

Users will now see this project as a possible choice in the Audio & MIDI Setup Wizard.

[h1]What's Coming?[/h1]
We're currently remixing our "Portal 2 - Want you Gone" demo project originally included with Music Creator 6 Touch. This will have updated style dials, plugins, and synths currently available with our entry level product [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/543510/]SONAR Home Studio[/url]. It has been removed for the time being from the tutorials DLC.

Once this is done, we'll be reintroducing it into the 'Demo Projects' folder mentioned above for all Steam SONAR users.

notes.title: 1.2017 Update News
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

We wanted to make users aware of what's going on in the next week in regards to update 1.2017.

While direct users have early access right now and may see a final release before the end of the week. Steam users will likely see this update early next week.

With this update we're adding a new standalone app for the updated LP-MB and LP-EQ plugins and investigating a personalization issue when upgrading between versions. 12.2016 users will also be receiving the personalization update.

Due to complexities and scale of this update, we want to add a few extra days of test to make sure everything is production ready before going live.

Best Regards,
Seth and all of Cakewalk

notes.title: Maintenance Update to 12.2016
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

We've pushed a small update out today which includes a new TH3 installer.

This is compatible with TH3's standalone installers, so users who purchase the full version should no longer experience issues. 

TH3 has moved from [steamlibrary]\common\cakewalk\vstplugins and steamlibrary]\common\cakewalk\x64\vstplugins

to

C:\Program Files\CommonFiles\VST3\ and C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files\VST3\

These paths should be added by default to SONAR's scanner, but if they are absent you can add them by going to Edit > Preferences > File > VST Settings

notes.title: SONAR 2017 - News, Changes, and Updates!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,
There's a bunch of changes coming down the pipe for 2017, and we wanted to let our users know right away.

[h1]New Pricing Structure:[/h1]
Our decades old loyalty pricing system was difficult to maintain on the Steam store and other retailers, causing multiple discount stacking issues and ultimately sowing confusion for end users. 

Starting with the 2017 season we'll be piloting a new flat pricing structure. This will instead allow us to be more flexible in our promotional offerings and participation in Steam community events. 

[h1]SONAR Platinum Lifetime:[/h1]
The [b]last day[/b] to purchase [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/500400/]SONAR Platinum Lifetime Passes[/url] will be January 2nd, 2017. 

After that, [b]only[/b] SONAR Platinum 2017 season passes will be available. Pricing on these packages will be in line with our new system mentioned above.

[h1]SONAR Professional:[/h1]
SONAR Professional 2017 Season Passes are [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/553861]now available![/url] Users who own the 2017 pass will be eligible for updates till 12.31.17. 

Coinciding with the pricing structure change, we'll be running a limited 35% launch discount on upgrade options. 

[h1]SONAR Steam Edition:[/h1]
With the introduction of our new beginner version - [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/543510]SONAR Home Studio[/url] we'll be retiring Steam Edition 2016 to simplify our offerings to new users. The last day Steam Edition 2016 will be available for sale is 1.2.17. Note: the '16 pass's last scheduled update is the 12.2016 release.

Moving forward, the last loyalty pricing offered will be a special one for Steam Edition 2016 users to upgrade to Professional 2017. This will expire rolling into the 2018 season.

[h1]Steam Specific Content:[/h1]
Over the course of next year, we'll be refactoring and updating the Steam specific content to enhance end user experiences. All offerings of SONAR on Steam will effectively become 'Steam Editions', including Home Studio.

[h1]Feedback:[/h1]
If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to start a thread in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/380080/discussions/0/]discussion forums![/url] We'll try to answer everything to the best of our ability.

notes.title: SONAR 2016.09 Update 1 - Is Now Available!
notes.notes:
SONAR 2016.09 Update 1 is now available for users to download. This release addresses the following issues:

[h1]General Issues:[/h1][list]
[*] Issues with Groove Clips and Tempo Changes
[*] String truncation affects paths for database, fault reports, bit bridge, etc.
[*] SONAR hangs instead of creating dump/reporting.
[*] Fault Reporter not running when expected.
[*] Fault Reporter connection issues.
[*] A failure to stop at end of Project
[*]UAD plugs are incompatible with Load Balancing. 
[b]Note:[/b] UAD plugins do not accept variable buffer sizes and are now ignored by Load Balancing. [/list]

[h1]Steam Specific Issues:[/h1][list]
[*]Plugin Update Error Messages on some configurations[/list]

[h1]Important Changes to Crash Managment:[/h1]
Some important changes have happened to the way SONAR handles crashes.

1) Our first priority is to immediately alert the user that a crash has occurred and to save a diagnostic dump, then launch fault reporter.

2) Next we help recover your project, if possible.  

When a crash occurs, there may be users that get audio buffers looping until they click the button on the crash dialog. Then we will try and close out the audio/midi devices. In the future we will make the project recovery step automatic to avoid having audio looping for any longer than necessary.

This change was implemented because shutting down hardware first caused hangs with no UI in some circumstances. The new changes should help safeguard data and better notify the user when issues happen. 

Please note: Users may now experience crashes when before they were experiencing hangs. The benefit to this is users will have a better chance to save their data and Cakewalk will now receive better diagnostic data.

As always, if users have any questions or issues, please create a thread in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/380080/discussions/2/]Technical Assistance Forum.[/url]

notes.title: Update - Japanese Localization Now Available!
notes.notes:
Cakewalk is happy to announce our Japanese localization is now available on Steam! 

This localization covers:[list]
[*] SONAR UI
[*] SONAR Start Page
[*] SONAR Local Help
[*] SONAR Readme
[*] Help Module
[*] Classic LP EQ/Compressor Local Help
[*] Cakewalk Publisher Local Help[/list]
Users who have already installed SONAR and would like to switch languages can do the following:[list]
[*] Right-Click on SONAR in your Steam Library
[*] Go to Properties
[*] Go to the 'Language' Tab
[*] Select your preferred language
[*] Switch to the 'Local Data' Tab
[*] Click the [Verify Integrity of Application Cache...] button.
[*] Allow Steam to finish the process, then launch SONAR.[/list]

This update applies to SONAR Steam Edition, Professional, and Platinum

notes.title: Update 2016.04 now Available!
notes.notes:
SONAR 2016.04 brings three exciting new plug-ins to SONAR.

Guitarists (and bassists) can look forward to Overloud TH3 Cakewalk Edition, which is available in all versions of SONAR. It features more refined and detailed algorithms, improved cabinet IR responses, and a classic bass amp emulation. 

Also included with Professional and Platinum are the new linear-phase mastering-quality plug-ins for multiband compression (LP-MB) and EQ (LP-EQ). Built from the ground up, the latest versions are a new design with superior performance, more options, and a more informative user interface.

In addition, there are new fixes and enhancements to the core program.

This is a free update for SONAR Steam Edition, Professional, and Platinum. 

Get more details in our [url=http://static.cakewalk.com/cakewalk/products/sonar/release_notes/Welcome_to_the_SONAR_2016.04_Update.pdf]eZine[/url]

https://www.cakewalk.com/Support/Knowledge-Base/2016000035/SONAR-2016-04-Update-Notes
